FIELDS.NAME: HomeHeat Solutions
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Chief Inspector, HomeHeat Solutions, 555-123-4567
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: HomeHeat Solutions specializes in the installation, maintenance, and repair of residential and light commercial boiler and furnace systems. Our operations are centered around providing high-quality heating solutions that prioritize safety and compliance with all local, state, and federal building codes. We focus on delivering exceptional service while ensuring that all our technicians are OSHA-certified and receive ongoing safety training. Our teams offer routine maintenance contracts to keep heating systems operating efficiently, and we also perform emergency repair services during peak seasons. Additionally, we adhere strictly to documented safety practices and use manufacturer-approved components to minimize risks associated with equipment failures. By maintaining an up-to-date safety program and actively reviewing our operational practices, we demonstrate a commitment to minimizing liability and ensuring customer satisfaction.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: HomeHeat Services, LLC - Residential HVAC Maintenance
FIELDS.PREVIOUS CARRIER: Previous insurer for HomeHeat Solutions was "Global Insurance Group".
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 09/15/2022, a minor leak was detected during a routine maintenance inspection in a residential furnace unit, leading to separate repairs totaling $1,200. The issue was caused by a worn gasket which was promptly replaced. Status: Resolved and documented.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and on-site watchpersons during service hours.
FIELDS.personal property valuation type: Replacement cost for new boiler and furnace installations compliant with local safety regulations.

The focus is solely on the installation, maintenance, and repair of heating systems in residential and light commercial environments.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – HomeHeat Solutions does not sponsor any athletic teams as part of its operations or business activities.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are required to provide a certificate of insurance before they can work. The chief inspector, John Smith, is responsible for checking these certificates to ensure compliance.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – HomeHeat Solutions has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – HomeHeat Solutions has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. We have maintained a consistent coverage history with our previous insurer.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – HomeHeat Solutions does not lease employees to or from other employers; all staff are directly employed and trained within the organization.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – HomeHeat Solutions carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and to provide coverage for employee injuries incurred while on the job.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – HomeHeat Solutions owns and operates another business, HomeHeat Services, LLC, which specializes in residential HVAC maintenance.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – HomeHeat Solutions does not have any other insurance policies with this company currently listed. We primarily focus on our existing coverage for heating system installation and repair operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – HomeHeat Solutions is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our focus is solely on the installation, maintenance, and repair of heating systems in residential and light commercial environments.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – HomeHeat Solutions does not rent or loan equipment to others; our focus is solely on providing installation and repair services directly to our clients.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – HomeHeat Solutions has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The company maintains a solid financial standing and continues to operate smoothly.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – HomeHeat Solutions does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals in its operations, focusing strictly on the installation and maintenance of heating systems. All activities are conducted in compliance with safety regulations to minimize any related risks.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – HomeHeat Solutions does not have any catastrophe exposure as their operations are limited to the installation and maintenance of heating systems in residential and light commercial environments, focusing on safety and compliance.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – HomeHeat Solutions has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The company maintains a strong commitment to compliance and ethical standards in its operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – HomeHeat Solutions currently has no uncorrected fire code violations and adheres to all applicable safety regulations and building codes.
